description: This Swift source file defines the `GatewayDiscoveryModel` class, which manages discovery and monitoring of network gateways using Bonjour/mDNS over NWBrowser. It handles starting/stopping discovery, parsing service records, maintaining state, and logging debug information.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: A final class that manages network gateway discovery using Bonjour/mDNS, maintains state, and supports debug logging.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DebugLogEntry
classes.description: A struct representing a debug log entry with timestamp and message.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: A struct representing a discovered network gateway with identifying information and status.

methods.name: setDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging, clearing logs when disabled.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts network discovery for gateways using Bonjour/mDNS.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops network discovery and clears internal state.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Updates the list of gateways based on recent discoveries, tracking added and removed gateways.

methods.name: updateStatusText
methods.description: Updates the status text based on current discovery states.

methods.name: prettyState
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string for a given NWBrowser.State.

methods.name: appendDebugLog
methods.description: Appends a message to the debug log if logging is enabled.

methods.name: prettifyInstanceName
methods.description: Normalizes gateway instance names for display.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts and trims a string value from a dictionary.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Extracts and converts a string value to an integer from a dictionary.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
